episodes.synopsis: 27th century. A human child awakens, with the mission to find the other humans, and bring peace between them and the mutant Enterrans ruling earth now.
episodes.title: Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo and her new friends land in a nest of Enterran bees.
episodes.title: Bee-Ware The Hunters

episodes.synopsis: A bunch of Enterrans spiders kidnaps Yakumo in believing a legend that eating a human will make the eater immortal.
episodes.title: Web of Evil

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo, Sago and Kutal are invited to join a festival, while Mushra still roams about. When he gets the chance to do a little revenge for being send away, he takes it.
episodes.title: Day At The Park

episodes.synopsis: Mushra finds a human child, who claims to have escaped from a prison for humans.
episodes.title: Kiri

episodes.synopsis: In an attempt to save Yakumo and Kiri from Daku, Sago comes up with the plan to be captured themselves.
episodes.title: Battling Daku

episodes.synopsis: Kutal's nieces and nephews show up and throw the gang on an unexpected adventure.
episodes.title: Into The Jungle

episodes.synopsis: As Mushra battles Waru, another Enterran named Gyasa, the King of the Snake-Enterrans, appears with the intention of taking out the gang and kidnapping Yakumo.
episodes.title: Reptilers

episodes.synopsis: Gyasa uses dirty tricks to take out Sago and Kutal, leaving Mushra by himself. Can he find a way to defeat Gyasa?
episodes.title: Gyasa

episodes.synopsis: Mushrambo is able to defeat Gyasa in his first form, but what will happen when he transforms?
episodes.title: Mushrambo: The Ultimate Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Mushrambo is overpowered by the Hyper Gyasa. Can he find a way to turn the tide of the battle around?
episodes.title: Clash of The Hyper Warriors

episodes.synopsis: Darba, the supposed wizard of Shinzo, appears with a proposition for the team, but what are his real intentions?
episodes.title: The Test

episodes.synopsis: The group arrives at another forest after going through the desert, but when Grandora the 3-Headed Ice Dragon attacks the village under Ungra and Ryuma's control, it means trouble for the entire team.
episodes.title: Ryuma, Lord of the Reptiles

episodes.synopsis: Mushrambo has been turned evil and is now Dark Mushrambo. Can anyone or anything defeat him?
episodes.title: Dark Spirit of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: The group arrives in a city full of robots, but what will they do when the cops begin to pursue them?
episodes.title: Mechano city

episodes.synopsis: What will the robots do when they learn that Yakumo is a human?
episodes.title: The giant robot

episodes.synopsis: Mushra and the robots find out about Yakumo's past and the truth about the robot king, but what happens when Mushra battles Cairis to the end in a one-on-one battle?
episodes.title: The great war

episodes.synopsis: As a machine is using the egg card's power to revive Mushra, Sago, and Kutal, King Nipper sacrifices his life in an attempt to stop Cairis and prevent him from killing Yakumo.
episodes.title: The secrets of the seven

episodes.synopsis: Mechano City has been destroyed, so Mushra and company decide to get revenge by attacking the Birdmen colonies. What they find is a new challenge, but can they be successful at overcoming it?
episodes.title: The feathered fiend

episodes.synopsis: Mushrambo must battle his evil self to prevent the young Yakumo from being killed, but can they succeed without gaining some new powers?
episodes.title: The two Mushrambo's

episodes.synopsis: The final battle between the two Mushrambo's is at hand, but which side will prevail?
episodes.title: The battle of one

episodes.synopsis: Mushra is trapped once again, but freed by the mysterious Binka, but when Lanancuras' servants attack them, can they survive without hyper power, or is there another way for Mushra to go hyper?
episodes.title: A new begining

episodes.synopsis: Binka and Mushra search for Sago so Mushrambo can be reformed, but what troubles await them in route?
episodes.title: Bear claws

episodes.synopsis: Eilis decides to target Mushra to prevent Mushrambo from ever being reborn. Can the team overcome him and keep Mushra alive?
episodes.title: Nightmare dream center

episodes.synopsis: It's Eilis vs. Mushrambo, but who will be the victor?
episodes.title: Eillis of the storm

episodes.synopsis: The group gets trapped in a never ending maze, and their only hope of escape is Yakumo. Can they succeed?
episodes.title: Reviving Yakumo

episodes.synopsis: It's Yakumo & Mushrambo vs. Lanancuras, but who has the bigger desire to win?
episodes.title: Lanancuras arises

episodes.synopsis: Lanancuras gains his full power and continues the battle against Mushrambo. Who will end up being the victor, especially when it appears that Yakumo is killed.
episodes.title: Lanancuras unbound

episodes.synopsis: Mushrambo continues his battle against Lanancuras, but does he stand a chance without the help of Yakumo and Binka?
episodes.title: Mushrambo meets his match

episodes.synopsis: Lanancuras' apparent death was unexpected and he appears to be headed toward being the ruler of the world, but Mushra refuses to give up and calls on a new power source to assist him. Will it be enough to defeat Lanancuras in the end?
episodes.title: Mushra's mission

episodes.synopsis: With all hope lost, Mushra vows to destroy Lanancuras once and for all, and with the guardian powers revealed he may just succeed. What will happen next?
episodes.title: Soul survivor

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Mushra and Lanancuras comes to its exciting conclusion, but whose lives will it cost?
episodes.title: Long live Yakumo
